'''Needa Kame''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].

==Biography==
A [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], Needa Kame was [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who took a leave of absence from active duty circa [[900 BBY/Legends|900 BBY]]. Traveling to [[Iktotch/Legends|Iktotch]] to meditate and study [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], Kame constructed a retreat into the mountains of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] and spent a decade in seclusion. During this time, Kame worked to develop a tool to make up for the species-wide lack of [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]] in Iktotchi. Constructing the [[Herder's Gauntlets]] and imbuing them with the Force, Kame stitched them from the hide and horns of a native ungulate. Despite the isolation, Kame occasionally had visitors from a nearby village, who brought the Jedi Master food and other supplies in order to receive advice from the wise master. Possessing a sense of humor, Kame became an icon among the village's children, who sought him out as a wise elder. The visits by the children eventually helped him complete the Gauntlet, as he realized that his application of the Force had been wanting.<ref name="NoP" />
